changelog: The popup takes the page's colours: its text colour is inherited from the form, and its background is the nearest one behind the form, up to the body's. Its title read #f4f1ea on white on a dark page before (WCAG 1.4.3).

The popup leaves the page's status line in place, with its text, so the page doesn't shift and still says which size is sold out after it closes. The dialog has its own status line for the reply and errors.

Set button colours win over the theme's WooCommerce button rules (!important, only while a colour is set) in the normal, hover, focus and disabled states, so the shopper sees the pair the contrast check passed.
The Requests list keeps a search with a plus sign (restock-test+120a) through Mark waiting, Unsubscribe, Delete and the confirmation's Cancel: RestockPage::url() encodes its values.
The sold-out option chooser's legend is "Width (sold out)", or "Sold-out options" for a product with more than one attribute, so it doesn't share a name with the picker's group.
The waiting count's sentence comes from wp.i18n._n() for the count, with the plugin's JSON translations, so languages with three or more plural forms read right.
A move to an alternative whose new request throws gives its claim back, so the link doesn't read as used.
"Lifetime spend, high to low" replaces "Lifetime spend, highest first".
The Back in stock, Still in stock and No longer available emails send through one RestockEmail::sendItem().
